content.text:
**Finding: compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).

No customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum fee exists anywhere in the agreement; the only "penalty" reference (§ 27.3) is a customer-favorable right to terminate without penalty, and § 7.1 bars unidentified minimum-use charges. The § 2.1 take-or-pay commitment is volume exposure properly handled under the minimum-commitment rule, not a liquidated-damages clause, so it is not flagged twice here. This sits at the preferred position, so no redline was proposed.
